failed_reason: Menos de 5 fotos reales/curadas del negocio disponibles (minimo del pipeline). Busqueda exhaustiva en MassageBook (fotos de negocio + miniaturas de servicio 100x100, genericas de stock), el sitio propio actual rootedtowardwellness.com (home + about, Squarespace), y el microsite legado swfl.massagetherapy.com (home, about-the-practitioner, testimonials) solo arrojo 3 fotos reales aptas para galeria (2 tomas de masaje + 1 interior de sala de tratamiento) mas 1 selfie de la terapeuta (solo apta como avatar pequeno, nunca como tile de galeria) y 1 logotipo/marca grafica (arbol-mujer, no es una foto). Yelp, Facebook, Instagram y ClassPass bloquearon el scraping (403/429) en multiples intentos con headers de navegador real; Google Maps no expone fotos sin renderizado JS/API key. Regla del pipeline (Fase 3): 'menos de 5 fotos reales -> marca FAILED y detente, no fuerces un build degradado'.
important_discovery: HALLAZGO CRITICO en profundizacion de Fase 1: el negocio indicado en el discovery original ("New Beginnings Bodywork & Wellness Studio", 1617 Santa Barbara Blvd Suite 9, Cape Coral FL 33991) esta DESACTUALIZADO. La misma terapeuta (Sarah Rodriguez, LMT, mismo telefono (239) 314-8569) re-marco su negocio como "Rooted Toward Wellness, LLC" (entidad nueva en Sunbiz: L24000184551, registrada 2024) y se MUDO a 1515 Cape Coral Pkwy E, Suite 6 (dentro de "Perfect 10 Aesthetics"), Cape Coral, FL 33904. Ademas ahora reparte su tiempo entre Cape Coral, FL y Kennesaw, GA (3450 Acworth Due West, Lake Point Wellness). Y lo mas importante: AHORA SI TIENE WEBSITE PROPIO -> https://www.rootedtowardwellness.com/ (Squarespace, resuelve DNS, HTTP 200, confirmado por curl). Esto contradice el dato de discovery "WEBSITE PROPIO: NO". Si se reintenta este negocio en el futuro (con mas fotos), el angulo de outreach debe ser 'propuesta de rediseno premium' (has_own_site:true), nunca 'les construimos un sitio de muestra porque no tienen'.

reviews.author: Josh Buzard
reviews.body: The only thing I can say is it's the best massage of my life. You honestly just have to experience her talent.
reviews.source: Google (dado en discovery, confirmado consistente con reseña MassageBook de Josh B.: "Best massage of my life")

reviews.author: Silvia Samarelli
reviews.body: Her body mapping technique is one of a kind. This was my first visit and it felt as if I have known her for years.

reviews.author: Lorna List
reviews.body: She is warm and engaging and extremely knowledgeable in her craft...I haven't felt this good after a massage in YEARS.

reviews.author: Kimberly Coe
reviews.body: Sarah is AMAZING! Her prices are more than reasonable and her bodymapping is a huge blessing to me!!!

reviews.author: Robert M.
reviews.body: I have chronic injuries and constantly search for a provider that is knowledgeable and skilled enough to work with my particular issues. Locally I have seen 4 other providers until I found my way here.

reviews.author: Jennifer P.
reviews.body: Every massage I have ever had I have walked away from feeling like I didn't get what I needed from the experience. My appt with Sarah was the exact opposite of that. She was truly incredible.

reviews.author: Michele C.
reviews.body: I have chronic pain so I was looking for someone who could help me. Sarah absolutely has a gift! I felt lighter, like I was standing straighter, and just on cloud 9.
